content:
You can create a project called Bug Bounty Finder with the following file structure:

1. Files:
- index.html
- style.css
- app.js
- data.json
- README.md

2. Dependencies/Libraries:
- jQuery
- Bootstrap

3. Code:
- HTML file (index.html) to display the user interface for searching bug bounty programs
- CSS file (style.css) for styling the user interface
- JavaScript file (app.js) to handle the functionality of searching bug bounty programs
- data.json file to store the data of bug bounty programs
- README.md file for documentation and instructions on how to use the tool

Ideas to improve the project:
- Include a feature to filter bug bounty programs based on the technology they are related to (e.g. web applications, mobile apps, IoT devices)
- Implement a feature to sort bug bounty programs by the date they were last updated or added
- Allow users to save their favorite bug bounty programs for easy access in the future
- Add a feature to track the status of bug bounty submissions and payouts
- Provide resources and tips on how to effectively participate in bug bounty programs

If you have any specific requirements or need further clarification on any aspect of the project, feel free to ask for more details.
